uutiset.s: New US restrictions on the export and access to top-end semiconductors risks denting Thailand’s ambitions to be a hub for data centers, the foreign minister said. uutiset.t: China Bank Rally Gains Momentum as Global AI Trade Unravels
uutiset.s: Chinese bank stocks are gaining a tailwind as turmoil around Nvidia Corp. deepens cracks in the artificial intelligence trade and drives investors toward defensive bets.

uutiset.t: Willy Shih on Risks With Nvidia’s Supply Chain
uutiset.s: Willy Shih, Harvard Business School professor of management practice, discusses how NVIDIA’s supplier network and rising purchase commitments help it reserve production capacity amid intense competition. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Ed Ludlow on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Australia Revamps Pension Fund Test to Unlock New Investment
uutiset.s: Australia’s government is overhauling the annual performance test for the nation’s pension funds, including introducing a new benchmark aimed at encouraging investment in a broader range of assets.

uutiset.t: China Is Finding Workarounds on Restrictions: Sara Hsu
uutiset.s: Sara Hsum University of Tennessee at Knoxville's Supply Chain Management Clinical Associate Professor says China has already been developing domestic supply chains and advanced semiconductors as a policy priority. She speaks with Romaine Bostick and Ed Ludlow on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Former Darden CEO: Cava Better Off As A Private Company
uutiset.s: Clarence Otis, Darden Restaurant's former Chairman and CEO discusses how restaurants are responding to rising food, labor and real estate costs as menu prices increase and consumers face more pressure on their budgets. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Nothing to Nitpick With Nvidia Results: Erika Klauer
uutiset.s: Ahead of NVIDIA’s results, Erika Klauer, CIO at Science and Technology Partners, says Jensen Huang has had an indelible impact on NVIDIA and the evolution of the AI business. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Gold Steadies Near 14-Month Low as Rate-Hike Pressure Mounts
uutiset.s: Gold was steady near a 14-month low, after Federal Reserve officials argued the case for more rate hikes to tackle stubborn inflation.

uutiset.t: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 18
uutiset.s: Oil steadied as traders assessed renewed fighting in the Middle East against signs of recovering supplies and higher US inventories.

uutiset.t: Fidelity Says Even at 6% Treasuries Fail to Be ‘Massively Cheap’
uutiset.s: The recent selloff in Treasuries has sparked debate about buying opportunities, but Fidelity International’s Salman Ahmed reckons that even a 6% yield wouldn’t make the 10-year note “massively cheap.”

uutiset.t: Apollo’s Rowan Says Insurance Will Power the $8 Trillion AI Boom
uutiset.s: Apollo Global Management Inc. Chief Executive Officer Marc Rowan said insurance and retirement capital will power an AI buildout that could demand as much as $8 trillion of financing.

uutiset.t: Putin Arrives in China for Trump, Xi Meeting
uutiset.s: Vladimir Putin arrived in Shenzhen Wednesday ahead of his meeting with Presidents Xi Jinping and Donald Trump during the annual APEC assembly on Thursday. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Nasdaq, S&P 500 Futures Rise After Nvidia Earnings: Markets Wrap
uutiset.s: US equity-index futures rose along with Asian shares after Nvidia Corp.’s sales forecast topped Wall Street estimates, easing concerns about the artificial intelligence trade following a recent selloff.

uutiset.t: Panama Pulled Back From Brink of Junk as Moody’s Lifts Outlook
uutiset.s: Panama moved away from the brink of a downgrade to junk territory after Moody’s Ratings dropped a negative outlook that had hung over the nation’s credit score for two years.
